title: storage-copy.test.tsx depends on test order: three tests fail under a shuffle because the fallback state lasts for the module's life
evidence: widget-src/standalone/storage-copy.test.tsx with --sequence.shuffle --sequence.seed=1794534984411: 3 of 28 fail on unmodified main (the two US-09 AC13 log-off-id tests and 'a notice already on screen drops the promise when the writes stop'), each 'expected ... to contain kept in this browser'.
